rates: USD per 1M tokens. Input counts cache reads and cache writes, which bill at cached_input and cache_write; output includes thinking tokens.
billing_note: billing free: the free tier, with no billing account, bills $0, and cost_paid is what the same tokens would cost on the paid tier. billing credits: prepaid Anthropic API credits pay for every token, so cost_billed is what the run spent, and the $0-billed gate applies to the free setup only.

claude-haiku-5-5.source: the user (2026-10-17): $0.10 in and $0.50 out for prompts up to 100K tokens; cache reads 0.1x and 5-minute cache writes 1.25x the input rate (Claude API pricing, as of 2026-10-06)
claude-haiku-5-5.note: Prompts over 100K tokens bill $0.50 and $2.50; none reaches that, since the 150,000-token cap counts every earlier prompt and a tool result adds at most 24 KB.

claude-opus-5-5.source: the claude-api skill's model table (2026-10-26): $4 in and $20 out per million tokens, cache reads $0.20 (0.05x); 5-minute cache writes 1.25x the input rate
claude-opus-5-5.note: The live planner's model (P2.1). It marks nothing for the cache, so its worst case bills input at $4.
